description: Land Acquisition - Amended Udathula, Pelmadulla D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Amended Ex. Gaz. No. 2338/07 dated 26.06.2023 Maritimepattu D/S Division, Mullaitivu District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains specific notices about government acquisition of land for public purposes (water treatment plant), including detailed descriptions of the land parcels, boundaries, claimants, and compensation procedures. This fits squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it concerns land acquisition, property ownership claims, and land use for public projects.
